title: Mithilesh Kumari v. State of U.P.
coram: Rajan Roy, J. and Manish Kumar, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; petitioner relegated to clause 6.5 EE remedy
headnote: A grievance against electricity bills is to be raised before the Executive Engineer under paragraph 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ was disposed without deciding the bills on merits.
facts: Mithilesh Kumari filed a writ at the Lucknow Bench of the Allahabad High Court against the State of U.P. through the Principal Secretary, Energy, Lucknow, and three others. The petitioner’s grievance was about electricity bills issued since 23 February 2022. The Division Bench of Rajan Roy and Manish Kumar JJ. heard the petition on 1 August 2025. The order gives no further particulars of the connection, the disputed demand, or any reply by the licensee.

holding_units.holding: The remedy for a grievance against electricity bills, if at all, is before the Executive Engineer under paragraph 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The petitioner was directed to avail that remedy and the writ was disposed of without a merits decision on the bills.
